integrity: Analytical scalar exact-arithmetic argument supplemented by deterministic computations; no human or independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the unstabilized c2=1 ETDRK2 scalar positive linear split is considered; small remainder-to-stiff-ratio regime; not a full global positivity phase diagram or a nonlinear/matrix result; prior literature already gives unconditional linear stability.
title: A reentrant positivity window for unstabilized second-order exponential Runge–Kutta decay
